diagnostics.message: The `aws_eks_addon` resource can report completion before its managed add-on components are ready; the CoreDNS managed add-on should be ordered after the EKS cluster has finished provisioning. The cluster ID is passed as a plain input, so it does not express this lifecycle dependency.

The `aws_eks_addon` resource can complete before the add-on is fully available; creation of the EBS CSI managed add-on should wait until the EKS cluster is established. Its cluster name is currently supplied through configuration without a dependency on the cluster lookup.

The EKS-managed kube-proxy add-on must be installed against an established EKS cluster; `cluster_name` is currently derived from plain context configuration and does not establish ordering after the cluster lookup.
